digest.component_or_area: workflow admission gates (plan review and completion verification)
propositions: Ticket descriptions exceeding 8,000 characters must block both plan review and completion verification before any LLM call or context assembly.

The 8,000-character maximum is derived from historical replay of 2,202 tickets showing p99 at 7,500 characters, affecting only 0.82% of current tickets while materially improving plan-review latency and completion-verifier PASS rates.

Light-tier bug review must retain blocking P4 description findings while downgrading other DET blocks to advisory, flowing the retained finding into the deterministic short circuit returning BLOCK with coverage.llm_ran=false.
AC-count and file-impact P4 signals remain advisory; only oversized description triggers admission block and P4 emits at most one oversize finding.
Completion verification must check description length after loading [verify] configuration and before child checks, returning deterministic FAIL with zero runner calls when exceeded.
Neither gate truncates or summarizes content; tickets must be reduced below the maximum before either gate runs.
